TEXT.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

S.FORM: Ka ni-k'mâto-hynna, rou ni-mattæ'i-kaha mattæ'i-limou-limou ki sou k'atta ta ti Jesus, ka ni-d'marang thaboul tou Galilæä, ka ni-iroua mou-arogh ki Jordaan tou paäpt-ten ki Judæa.
S.TRANSL: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;
耶穌說完了這些話，就離開加利利，來到猶太的境界約旦河外。

S.FORM: Ka ni-mææuugh tyni-æn ta mabatoung ki makoi-lalaulau, ka ni-pædærikæh tyn neini-æn tou hynna.
S.TRANSL: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.
有許多人跟着他，他就在那裏把他們的病人治好了。

S.FORM: Ka ni-iroua tyni-æn ta Fariséen ki rih-pung-ah tyni-æn, k'ma, Hahei-en kaua ta taou padarang ki kæ'i-æn tyn alei ki mamang?
S.TRANSL: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?
有法利賽人來試探耶穌，說：「人無論甚麼緣故都可以休妻嗎？」

S.FORM: Nda ni-mattæ'i-v'lli ta teni k'ma neini-æn, Assi-moumi lava ni-ktung, ka teni ka ni-mei-ryngei [ki kaæuloung] tou naunamou, ka ni-pei-ryngei tyn neini-æn ta pæræh ta jna?
S.TRANSL: And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,
耶穌回答說：「那起初造人的，是造男造女，

S.FORM: Ka ni-komm'appa, Alei ki anna d'marang-ah ta taou ki Rama ki Reina, ka saul-lam-ah ki kæ'i-en tyn, ka rarouha ka-anna saäsat-ah ki vaat.
S.TRANSL: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?
並且說：『因此，人要離開父母，與妻子連合，二人成為一體。』這經你們沒有念過嗎？

S.FORM: K'ma-hynna ka assi rarouha ta neni, nda dyk saäsat ki vaat. Anna ka ni-papa-sâl ki Alid assi pæpæhpiæh-auh ki kaæuloung.
S.TRANSL: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
既然如此，夫妻不再是兩個人，乃是一體的了。所以，上帝配合的，人不可分開。」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma [ta neni] tyni-æn, Kaoumang ka ni-pakou-sou-en ti Moses ka p'hæ-en-eih ta soulat ki pad'-ad'-arad'-arang, ka pad'-arang-auh ta teini [ka kæi-en ki pæræh?]
S.TRANSL: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?
法利賽人說：「這樣，摩西為甚麼吩咐給妻子休書，就可以休她呢？」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma [ta teni] neini-æn, Ni-hahei-en-kamou ti Moses alei ki 'thægh-oumi ki tintin ka pad'-a-rang-ah-kamou ki kæ̈i-'en-noumi: Râ assi ni-k'ma-hynna tou nauna-mou.
S.TRANSL: He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.
耶穌說：「摩西因為你們的心硬，所以許你們休妻，但起初並不是這樣。

S.FORM: Râ koun-nau-kamou, timamang ta padarang ki kæ'i-æn tyn, dou assi alei ki kavei-joung-an, ka mæ'jæ̈ ki pani, 'rbourbo-atou-ra, ka timamang ta mæ'iæ̈ ki ni-pad'arang, 'rbourbo-[appa-ra.]
S.TRANSL: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.
我告訴你們，凡休妻另娶的，若不是為淫亂的緣故，就是犯姦淫了；有人娶那被休的婦人，也是犯姦淫了。」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma tyni-æn ta Pahtatæutæu-han tyn, Heirou komma-hynna ta kidi ki ka'æuloung ki kæ'iæ̈n tyn, assi mariang ka mæ'iæ̈-ah.
S.TRANSL: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.
門徒對耶穌說：「人和妻子既是這樣，倒不如不娶。」

S.FORM: Teni-ra ni-kma neini-æn, Assi pæh-ymmid pæh-balei ki sou k'atta, dyk neini-æn ka ni-p'hæ-æn-ato.
S.TRANSL: But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.
耶穌說：「這話不是人都能領受的，惟獨賜給誰，誰才能領受。

S.FORM: Ka akoume-'ato ki ni-æ̈hæp, ka ni-pei-alak-kin komma-hynna ki vouil ki rena [nein]: ka akou-meä ki ni-æ̈hæp ka ni-æ̈hæp ki kaæuloung: ka akoume-'appa ki ni-æ̈hæp ka ni-mæhæp neini-æn tei-mado alei ki Pei-sasou-an ki tounnoun ki vullu-vullum. Timamang ta pæh-lpough pæh-balei [ki atta] Pæh-balei-auto.
S.TRANSL: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother's womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven's sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.
因為有生來是閹人，也有被人閹的，並有為天國的緣故自閹的。這話誰能領受就可以領受。」

S.FORM: Tou kidi k'anna ni-âd' paou-koua tyni-æn ta rarauwei ka atta-halap-eih tyn ta rima neini-æn, tou pako-Alilid-den: nda ni-patymhga'n ta neini ki Pahtatæutæu-han.
S.TRANSL: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.
那時，有人帶着小孩子來見耶穌，要耶穌給他們按手禱告，門徒就責備那些人。

S.FORM: Râ ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus, Souroung-an-ei ta rarauwei, ynna mavagh neini-æn pa-ou-koua jau-an: alei ka â neini ta Pei-sasou-an ki tounnoun ki vullu-vullum.
S.TRANSL: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.
耶穌說：「讓小孩子到我這裏來，不要禁止他們；因為在天國的，正是這樣的人。」

S.FORM: Irou ka ni-atta-halap-en tyn ta rima neini-æn, ni-thaboul ta teni d'marang hynna.
S.TRANSL: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.
耶穌給他們按手，就離開那地方去了。

S.FORM: Ka k'ytt'ei, ka saät [ki vouel] ta ni-mou-koua ka ni-k'ma tyni-æn, Tama-mahtæutæuuh ka mariang, pam't-au-mau ta riang ki mang, tou akoumea-ei-mau ki kæuæg-han ka myh-kakoua myddarynnough?
S.TRANSL: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?
有一個人來見耶穌，說：「夫子，我該做甚麼善事才能得永生？」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta teni tyni-æn, Ka mang ta pa-nanang-en-hou jau-an ka mariang? Aousi ta timamang ka mariang, dyk sâsat ki Alid. Heirou mamoei kow mourbo tou kæuæg-han, nda ah-koua-au ta na sou ki ni-pakou-sou-en [tou Tatouhko.]
S.TRANSL: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.
耶穌對他說：「你為甚麼以善事問我呢？只有一位是善的。你若要進入永生，就當遵守誡命。」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta teni tyni-æn, Sou ka mang? Nda ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus [Atta:] Assi kow louhpough-ah: Assi kow mou-zouzoung-ah ki ni-makakyttil: Assi kow haouzoung-ah: Assi kow hmæ'il-ah sihaharang.
S.TRANSL: He saith unto him, Which? Jesus said, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,
他說：「甚麼誡命？」耶穌說：「就是不可殺人；不可姦淫；不可偷盜；不可作假見證；

S.FORM: Milligh-a-kow ti Am-au-hou-en ti In-au-hou-en: ka, Mævæ'ang-o-ah kow ki ta'u ka rarouma mama mamado ymhou-an.
S.TRANSL: Honour thy father and thy mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
當孝敬父母；又當愛人如己。」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma tyni-æn ta kæuh-pæpæræh, Ymd-dennau milligh ta mamang k'atta ki na kararauwei-au: Ka mang ta äou-si-appa jau-an?
S.TRANSL: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?
那少年人說：「這一切我都遵守了，還缺少甚麼呢？」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus tyni-æn, Irou mamoei kow mænænæh mataraæuh, oukouâ, pa-zadumm'â ki mamang oho, ka p'hæ-eito ki malimouk, ka akou-me'ah kow ki vangei tou tounnoun ki vullum: ka mou-kouâ hia, mææuugh jau-an-da.
S.TRANSL: Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go and sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.
耶穌說：「你若願意作完全人，可去變賣你所有的，分給窮人，就必有財寶在天上；你還要來跟從我。」

S.FORM: Irou ka millingigh ki sou k'atta ta Kæuh-pæpæræh, ni-d'marang ta teni mavoulas, alei ka akoumea tyni-æn ki madagh ki hourup.
S.TRANSL: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.
那少年人聽見這話，就憂憂愁愁地走了，因為他的產業很多。

S.FORM: Nda ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus ki Pahtatæutæu-han tyn, Missing koun-nau-kamou-ra, ka mag-hogpyt ta mavangei mou-rbo tou pei-sasou-an ki tounnoun ki vullum.
S.TRANSL: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.
耶穌對門徒說：「我實在告訴你們，財主進天國是難的。

S.FORM: Ka he-la-en-au-kamou masousou, Ka si-ourou hmah-ei ta louang ka makhgoun ki rikour tau-koua tou lbas ki simsim, ka mou-rbo-ah ta mavangei tou peisasou-an ki Alid.
S.TRANSL: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
我又告訴你們，駱駝穿過針的眼，比財主進上帝的國還容易呢！」

S.FORM: Tou illing-hen [ki atta] ki Pahtatæutæu-han tyn, ouhang ni-mouhkiap ta neni, ka ni-k'ma, Timang ta paka-lpoug-eih rou anna paka-riang?
S.TRANSL: When his disciples heard it, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?
門徒聽見這話，就希奇得很，說：「這樣誰能得救呢？」

S.FORM: Ka dou 'ararau ti Jesus ni-k'ma neini-æn, Assi pæi-lpoug-hen ta atta tou ka'æuloung-an, râ pæi-lpoug-hen ymmid ki mamang ki Alid.
S.TRANSL: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
耶穌看着他們，說：「在人這是不能的，在上帝凡事都能。」

S.FORM: Tou kidi k'anna dou mattæ'i-villi ta ti Petrus ni-k'ma tyni-æn, K'ytt'ei, ni-saou-ymd-änian sau-tauagh ki mamang, ka ni-mæuæuugh-kame ymhou-an: mamang-al-ato ymiæn-æn?
S.TRANSL: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?
彼得就對他說：「看哪，我們已經撇下所有的跟從你，將來我們要得甚麼呢？」

S.FORM: Nda ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus neini-æn, Missing koun-nau-kamou-râ, ka ymoumi ka ni-mæuæuug jau-an tou pei-likoug-hen mei-alak, rou mier-roung-al-ato ta Alak ki ka'æuloung tou iraroung-an ki tounnoun ki karæræmæg-hen ki kidi tyn, ka mierroung-al-appa-kamou tou sât kytti-æn 'æb ki rouha ki ierraroung-an ka tounnoun pæmæmæh ki sât kytti-æn 'æb ki rouha ki kavouy-vouyl-an ti Israël.
S.TRANSL: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
耶穌說：「我實在告訴你們，你們這跟從我的人，到復興的時候，人子坐在他榮耀的寶座上，你們也要坐在十二個寶座上，審判以色列十二個支派。

S.FORM: Ka timamang ta sau-tauagh-al-ato ki tallagh, ki tæ'iæ-papara, ki niæ̈ha, ki rama, ki rena, ki kæi-æn, ki alalak, ki ouma-ouma lava alei ki Nanang-au, teni ta âbli-ah mara ki sât kæ'æ̈toug-han, ka ta-bli-al-appa ki kæuæg-han ka myhkakoua myddarynnough.
S.TRANSL: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name's sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.
凡為我的名撇下房屋，或是弟兄、姊妹、父親、母親、兒女、田地的，必要得着百倍，並且承受永生。

S.FORM: Râ mabatoung ki si-ouro-ouro ta si-æ̈æugh-al-ato, ka mabatoung ki si-æ̈æugh ta si-ouro-ouro-al-ato.
S.TRANSL: But many that are first shall be last; and the last shall be first.
然而，有許多在前的，將要在後；在後的，將要在前。」
